name: Game template - scroller
description: The original Proto Scroller Act 1: giant-robot combat, structural destruction, Business district encounters, first boss, salvage shop, and original title/loading screens.

[application]

config/use_custom_user_dir=true
config/custom_user_dir_name="manus-game-scroller-act1"

config/name="Proto Scroller — Act 1"
run/main_scene="res://scenes/main/main.tscn"

window/stretch/mode="canvas_items"
window/stretch/aspect="expand"
